name: graph_bug_list
title: graph.bug_list
description: Every bug persisted for a repository, admitted or not, one compact row each: verdict, admission, reproducer tier, path tier, and importance. Backs /inspect-bugs and the per-run bug count in /list-runs. Reuses the same assembly logic export_dataset uses for bugs.csv, so a caller sees the same numbers either way rather than a second, independently-computed view of the same graph.

runId.description: Used only to resolve which repository to list. Bugs are returned for the WHOLE repository, not filtered to this one runId's findings, for the same reason export_dataset joins on Bug.fixSha rather than a strict runId match.

outputSchema.description: Describes the `data` payload ONLY. The envelope { ok, evidenceId, data | unknown } is universal and enforced by modules/mcpserver.
